terminals.name: earthworm-compose
terminals.description: Root Compose: Earthworm web API (internal :8010) + nginx UI on :8081. Other apps: docker compose --profile ppsd|stationxml|ringserver up.

terminals.name: ppsd-backend
terminals.description: PPSD FastAPI + ObsPy backend on :8000. FDSNWS_URL points at the public IRIS server because the repo default (172.31.100.100) is an internal-only network. API docs at /docs; health at /api/health.

terminals.name: ppsd-frontend
terminals.description: PPSD React/Vite viewer on :5173 (proxies /api to the backend on :8000). Open the Single tab, pick a station (e.g. IU / ANMO / 00 / BHZ) and Compute PPSD.
